prompt: I had a really bad day at work.
completion:
I’m really sorry to hear that. Bad days at work can feel like a lot—stress, frustration, maybe even feeling like you’re not getting anywhere. It’s okay to let that go on for a while and just acknowledge it.

If you feel like talking through what happened or why it felt so tough, I’m here. Even just listing out what stood out can sometimes help make the load feel lighter. If you’d rather just vent or want a quick break, I can share a short breathing exercise or a few simple ways to reset your energy right now. Let me know what you need.
